decisions.reason: Management remains committed due to prior investment, public launch on the home page, and alignment with the announced innovation direction, making a drop unlikely in the coming year.
As a multi-model product line, this represents a larger sunk investment and stronger public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping even less likely.
